page.overview:
Who is Jobin Higashikata?

Jobin is the eccentric eldest son of the Higashikata Family. He is married to Mitsuba Higashikata and has a son, Tsurugi. Beyond his job at the Higashikata Fruit Company, Jobin was formerly one of the members of the Rock Humans' Locacaca Organization. Jobin is a Stand User and wields the mysterious Speed King.

Jobin is a man of average to above-average height and medium build. He has four grooves cross his face vertically, over the corner and the center of his eyes. As a kid Jobin didn't have these grooves at all but upon reaching sixteen, two of the grooves had mysteriously formed. The grooves are reduced to one on each side in subsequent appearances. He has an eyebrow that divides centrally, where it curls upwards.

Wearing an undercut, the hair on his sides was of medium tone and textured by short, bulbous spikes; whilst the light hair on his crown is folded onto the right of his forehead, where it is keeps with a barette.

He wears an overall light colored outfit of pants and a hooded top both bearing bulbous spikes. The hooded section is dark in color; and the second of two buttons on it bears the Higashikata Family crest. Jobin also wears a small, weaved necklace.
